title: nf-core/scdownstream pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

filtered.errorMessage: Filtered file must be a .h5ad, .h5, .rds or .csv file.

unfiltered.errorMessage: Unfiltered file must be a .h5ad, .h5, .rds or .csv file.

batch_col.errorMessage: Batch column needs to start with a letter and can contain letters, numbers, underlines and dashes.

symbol_col.errorMessage: Symbol column needs to start with a letter and can contain letters, numbers, underlines and dashes.

geneid_col.errorMessage: Gene ID column needs to start with a letter and can contain letters, numbers, underlines and dashes.

label_col.errorMessage: Label column needs to start with a letter and can contain letters, numbers, underlines and dashes.

condition_col.errorMessage: Condition column needs to start with a letter and can contain letters, numbers, underlines and dashes.

unknown_label.errorMessage: Unknown label needs to start with a letter and can contain letters, numbers, underlines and dashes.

counts_layer.errorMessage: Counts layer needs to start with a letter and can contain letters, numbers, underlines and dashes.

min_genes.errorMessage: Minimum number of genes must be an integer greater than 0.

min_cells.errorMessage: Minimum number of cells must be an integer greater than 0.

min_counts_cell.errorMessage: Minimum number of counts per cell must be an integer greater than 0.

min_counts_gene.errorMessage: Minimum number of counts per gene must be an integer greater than 0.

max_mito_percentage.errorMessage: Max mitochondrial percentage must be an integer between 0 and 100.

min_ribo_percentage.errorMessage: Min ribosomal percentage must be an integer between 0 and 100.

max_hb_percentage.errorMessage: Max haemoglobin percentage must be an integer between 0 and 100.

log1p_total_counts_nmads.errorMessage: MAD cutoff for log1p_total_counts must be a non-negative number. 0 disables MAD filtering for this metric.

log1p_n_genes_by_counts_nmads.errorMessage: MAD cutoff for log1p_n_genes_by_counts must be a non-negative number. 0 disables MAD filtering for this metric.

pct_counts_in_top_20_genes_nmads.errorMessage: MAD cutoff for pct_counts_in_top_20_genes must be a non-negative number. 0 disables MAD filtering for this metric.

pct_counts_mt_nmads.errorMessage: MAD cutoff for pct_counts_mt must be a non-negative number. 0 disables MAD filtering for this metric.

expected_cells.errorMessage: Number of cells expected from the experimental design, used as input to cellbender.

doublet_rate.errorMessage: doublet_rate must be a number between 0 and 1.
